nodes.description: Public mapping (address => uint) storing token balances; read and mutated by transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping (owner => spender => uint) storing allowances; written by approve and transferFrom.
Total token supply, set in constructor from the _supply argument.
Privileged owner address, assigned to msg.sender in the constructor and used in access-control checks.
Constant decimals value (18) of the token.
Constant internal Uniswap v2 router address used in pool pair derivation.
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom guarded by the SwapAndFarmingForGarDeners modifier; updates allowance and balances.
Public payable approve that writes the caller's allowance entry for a spender.
Public payable function gated by a privileged-address check that performs a delegatecall to a user-supplied address with user-supplied data.
Public payable batch airdrop gated by the same privileged-address check; computes an unchecked total and loops over recipients.
Payable constructor setting token metadata, privileged addresses, owner and initial balance of msg.sender.
Internal pure helper computing a Uniswap-like pair address from factory, tokenA and tokenB.
Modifier applied to transferFrom that derives the UNI pair and restricts sender/recipient to a whitelist of privileged pools.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, balance ownership and privileged-role checks.
Low-level delegatecall(a, b) to an arbitrary user-supplied address executing untrusted code in this contract's storage context.
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length and subsequent balance subtractions that can overflow/underflow.
Recipient parameter of transfer, forwarded into transferFrom.
Amount parameter used across transfer, transferFrom, approve and batchSend accounting.
Source account parameter of transferFrom whose allowance and balance are debited.
Spender parameter used as the allowance mapping key in approve.
Untrusted target address passed to delegatecall inside delegate.
Untrusted calldata passed to delegatecall inside delegate.
Array of recipient addresses iterated over by batchSend.
Local total = _value * _tos.length computed with unchecked arithmetic.
Loop index iterating the _tos recipient array.

edges.reason: transfer has no logic of its own and forwards the call to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
msg.sender is used as _from, letting the caller spend their own allowance path and drive balanceOf/allowance updates.
_to recipient parameter is forwarded into transferFrom and credited in balanceOf.
_value parameter flows into the allowance subtraction and balance updates of transferFrom.
balanceOf is read for the require check and written for both sender and recipient.
allowance is read and decremented when msg.sender differs from _from.
_spender is the second key of the allowance mapping written by approve.
_value is stored as the allowance amount in approve.
allowance[msg.sender][_spender] is assigned inside approve.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key and event argument in approve.
Untrusted address a is the target of the delegatecall, allowing execution of arbitrary code (e.g. selfdestruct) in this contract's context.
Untrusted bytes b is forwarded as delegatecall calldata with no validation of selector or payload.
msg.sender must match one of the privileged addresses before the delegatecall executes.
The delegatecall reads target a and data b from caller input, giving callers storage-level control if they hold any privileged role.
_tos array supplies the recipients iterated over in the batchSend loop.
_value is credited per recipient and used to compute the debited total.
msg.sender is checked against the privileged-address whitelist before the batch send executes.
batchSend computes _value * _tos.length without SafeMath, so the multiplication can overflow.
Local total is the unguarded product that is later subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender].
The unchecked total drives balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total and the per-recipient += _value updates.
balanceOf is read for the sufficiency require and written for the sender and each recipient.
The UNI constant participates in the pool address derivation inside the modifier.
pairFor is invoked by the modifier to compute the UNI pair address used in the whitelist check.
The modifier wraps transferFrom, requiring the derived pair or _from/_to to be in the privileged whitelist.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints totalSupply to msg.sender.
owner is one of the privileged addresses whose comparison gates the delegatecall.
Loop index i controls iteration over _tos inside batchSend.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a transfer recipient parameter consumed by transferFrom, so it collapses into that function.
_value is the amount parameter whose accounting is performed entirely in transferFrom.
_from is the debited source account parameter of transferFrom.
_spender is the allowance key parameter directly consumed by approve.
Address a is the untrusted delegatecall target of delegate.
Bytes b is the untrusted delegatecall payload of delegate.
_tos is the recipient array iterated by batchSend.
total is exactly the result of the unchecked multiplication that constitutes the unsafe operation.
i is only the loop counter of the batchSend recipient iteration.
